tools.name: postcode_lookup
tools.description: Returns detailed data for one UK postcode, matched regardless of letter case or spacing. Returns 404 if the postcode is not found; if it was previously active, the response includes a terminated property. Use postcode_search for nearest postcodes or text search, and bulk_postcode_lookup for many postcodes at once.

arguments.name: postcode
arguments.description: UK postcode to look up, with or without spaces, e.g. SW1A 1AA.

tools.name: bulk_postcode_lookup
tools.description: Makes one request for up to 100 postcodes, or for up to 100 coordinate pairs. Pass postcodes to get data for each postcode; postcodes that are not found have a null result. Pass geolocations to get the nearest postcodes to each longitude and latitude pair, sorted nearest first; invalid geolocations have a null result. limit, radius and widesearch apply to the geolocation search. Pass one of postcodes or geolocations.

arguments.name: postcodes
arguments.description: JSON array of up to 100 postcode strings to look up.

arguments.name: geolocations
arguments.description: JSON array of up to 100 objects, each with longitude and latitude fields.

arguments.name: filter
arguments.description: Comma-separated attribute names to include in each result object.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Maximum postcodes returned for each location; must be less than 100.

arguments.name: radius
arguments.description: Search radius in metres for the geolocation search; must be less than 2000.

arguments.name: widesearch
arguments.description: true extends the geolocation search radius up to 20km and returns at most 10 results.

tools.name: postcode_search
tools.description: Finds postcodes. Pass postcode to get the postcodes nearest to that postcode, ordered by distance; returns 404 if the input postcode is not found. Otherwise pass q for a text search, or lon and lat for the nearest postcodes to a coordinate, where each result includes a distance in metres. widesearch runs a coordinate search over up to 20km and ignores radius and limit; it does not apply to postcode or text searches.

arguments.name: postcode
arguments.description: Postcode to search from, with or without spaces. When given, the nearest postcodes to it are returned.

arguments.name: q
arguments.description: Text to search postcodes for. Used when postcode is not given.

arguments.name: lon
arguments.description: Longitude, WGS84 between -180 and 180. Use together with lat for a coordinate search.

arguments.name: lat
arguments.description: Latitude, WGS84 between -90 and 90. Use together with lon for a coordinate search.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Maximum results to return, max 100.

arguments.name: radius
arguments.description: Search radius in metres, max 2000.

arguments.name: widesearch
arguments.description: true runs a wide area search up to 20km returning at most 10 results; ignores radius and limit. Coordinate search only.

tools.name: postcode_autocomplete
tools.description: Returns postcodes matching a partial postcode, up to limit results. Use this when only part of a postcode is known.

arguments.name: postcode
arguments.description: Partial UK postcode to match, e.g. SW1A.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Maximum number of matches to return; must be less than 100.

tools.name: random_postcode
tools.description: Returns one random UK postcode with all its available data. Pass outcode, such as CM8 or SW1, to choose only from that outward code; an invalid outcode returns null.

arguments.name: outcode
arguments.description: Outward code to filter by, e.g. CM8 or SW1. Optional.

tools.name: outcode_lookup
tools.description: Returns detailed information about one UK outward code, the first half of a postcode. Matching is case-insensitive; returns 404 if not found. Use outcode_nearest to find neighbouring outcodes.

arguments.name: outcode
arguments.description: UK outward code, the first half of a postcode, e.g. BR8.

tools.name: outcode_nearest
tools.description: Returns outcodes ordered by proximity. Pass lon and lat together to find the nearest outcodes to a coordinate; otherwise pass outcode to find neighbours of that outcode, which returns 404 if the outcode is not found. Each result has the same shape as an outcode lookup.

arguments.name: lon
arguments.description: Longitude, WGS84 between -180 and 180. Use together with lat.

arguments.name: lat
arguments.description: Latitude, WGS84 between -90 and 90. Use together with lon.

arguments.name: outcode
arguments.description: Outward code to find neighbours of, e.g. NW1. Used when lon and lat are not both given.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Maximum outcodes returned; max 100.

arguments.name: radius
arguments.description: Search radius in metres; max 25000.

tools.name: place
tools.description: Looks up GB places. Pass code to get one place by its OSGB code, which returns 404 if not found. Pass q to search places by name: full-text match on primary and secondary names, falling back to prefix matching, returning an empty array or up to limit places. If both are given, code is used.

arguments.name: code
arguments.description: OSGB code of the place, e.g. osgb4000000074564391.

arguments.name: q
arguments.description: Text to search place names for.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Maximum places returned for a search, max 100.

tools.name: random_place
tools.description: Returns one random GB place with all its data. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: terminated_postcode_lookup
tools.description: Looks up a terminated UK postcode, one no longer in use. Matches with or without the space and in any letter case; returns 404 if not found.

arguments.name: postcode
arguments.description: Terminated UK postcode to look up, with or without spaces, e.g. E1W1UU.

tools.name: scottish_postcode_lookup
tools.description: Looks up the Scottish Postcode Directory record for a Scottish postcode. A 404 means the postcode is not in the directory; a 404 with the message 'Postcode exists in ONSPD but not in SPD' means it is only in ONSPD.

arguments.name: postcode
arguments.description: Scottish postcode to look up, e.g. AB101XG.
